title: THE DOWNED BLOCK SITS ON ONE PLATE AND THE TIMER IS THE BIG NUMBER
why: Critic on screen 34 (P0): the downed words sat straight on the red wash and the busy world, with the timer small. They now sit on one shared panel sized to their rows, and the timer is as big as the word down. Layout and keys are unchanged.
now: When you are down, the down word, the bar, the timer and the prompts now sit on one dark panel, and the timer is big.

edits.replacement: ctx.font=_fH; ctx.fillStyle=(p.dbGainT>DB_POP*0.5)?'#9fe8b0':'#ffb0a0'; ctx.textAlign='left';   // v28.xx (cw-downplate): the timer is the hero, as big as the word down
